items.title: Textron Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Textron (NYSE:TXT) reported second-quarter revenue growth of 3% to $3.8 billion, while adjusted earnings rose to $1.62 per share from $1.55 a year earlier. The company maintained its full-year adjusted earnings outlook of $6.40 to $6.60 per share and manufacturing cash flow guidance of $700 million

items.title: Textron Beats Earnings Estimates but Guidance and Funding Risks Weigh on Shares
items.summary: Textron Inc. (NYSE:TXT) reported second-quarter results that exceeded earnings expectations on Tuesday, but investor sentiment weakened after the company maintained its full-year outlook while highlighting potential risks tied to government funding for a key defence programme.

items.title: Textron (TXT) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
items.summary: Textron (TXT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +6.58% and +0.15%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Textron (NYSE:TXT) Reports Q2 CY2026 In Line With Expectations
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company Textron (NYSE:TXT) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 3% year on year to $3.83 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.62 per share was 4.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Textron (TXT) Q2 Earnings Report Preview: What To Look For
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company Textron (NYSE:TXT) will be announcing earnings results this Tuesday before market open. Here’s what investors should know.

items.title: Textron to Post Q2 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
items.summary: TXT's Q2 sales are likely to rise as Aviation, Bell and Systems strength offsets Industrial weakness, while higher costs pressure earnings.

items.title: 3 Industrials Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: Industrials businesses quietly power the physical things we depend on, from cars and homes to e-commerce infrastructure. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the industry’s six-month return of 6.3% has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 8.6% rise.

items.title: RTX Q2 Earnings Outpace Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: RTX beats Q2 estimates as commercial aftermarket and defense demand drive revenue growth, lift backlog to $289B and prompt a higher 2026 outlook.
